title: Sentinel Findings
description: Schema for api-findings.json and browser-findings.json produced by the api-sweeper and browser-sweeper agents. Contains sweep metadata and an array of findings.

mode.description: Sweep mode: api for API-only sweeps, browser for browser sweeps.

rolesTested.description: List of roles exercised during the sweep.

endpointsTested.description: Total number of API endpoints tested.

routesTested.description: Total number of browser routes tested.

startedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sweep started.

finishedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the sweep finished.

responseTimePercentiles.description: Response time percentile data (v1.8.0+). Contains global and per-endpoint p50/p95/p99/avg.

findings.description: Array of individual findings discovered during the sweep.

finding.description: A single finding from the sweep.

category.description: Finding category indicating the type of check that produced it.

endpoint.description: API endpoint in METHOD /path format (e.g. GET /api/v1/users). Null for non-endpoint findings.

route.description: Frontend route path (e.g. /admin/users). Null for non-route findings.

role.description: Role that triggered the finding (e.g. admin, manager, user, unauthenticated).

expected.description: What was expected. Null if not applicable.

actual.description: What was actually observed. Null if not applicable.

fileRef.description: Source file and line reference (e.g. endpoints/users.py:45). Null if unknown.

fixSuggestion.description: Suggested fix for the finding. Null if none.

breakpoint.description: Viewport width in pixels that triggered the finding. Null for non-layout findings.

screenshot.description: Relative path to a screenshot file. Null if no screenshot was captured.

service.description: Service name in multi-service mode (v1.3.0+). Null in single-service mode.
